title: Article 334 — Reservation of seats and special representation to cease after certain period

content.study:
Topic at a Glance
Article 334 of the Constitution of India is titled “Reservation of seats and special representation to cease after certain period”. It forms an integral component of Special Provisions relating to Certain Classes (Articles 330–342A), located within the “Special classes” cluster. Current through the 106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023.

Constitutional Text & Anatomy
Notwithstanding anything in the foregoing provisions of this Part, the provisions of this Constitution relating to—

(a) the reservation of seats for the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes in the House of the People and in the Legislative Assemblies of the States; and

(b) the representation of the Anglo-Indian community in the House of the People and in the Legislative Assemblies of the States by nomination, notified). number of members of the community to the Assembly as he considers appropriate\
